ColumnDeleteDestinationHelp: The column that receives every ticket before deletion. KittyClaw also removes routes that targeted the deleted column.

Title: Title
NoDescription: No description — click ✎ to add one.
ChatPickAgentTooltip: Pick an agent to chat about this ticket
ColumnProcessorHint: This generic agent processes the first eligible ticket in this column. KittyClaw owns execution and routing.
ProcessorDraftNotice: No processor is registered for this column yet. The values below are a draft and will only take effect after you save it.
ProcessorEnabledHelp: Controls whether KittyClaw may automatically select and process a ticket from this column. A disabled processor keeps its configuration but starts no agent.
ProcessorNameHelp: Human-readable processor name. KittyClaw displays it in the UI and uses it as the author of events added to the ticket activity.
ProcessorMissionHelp: The stable, required objective of the role attached to this column. KittyClaw injects it first in the agent profile to define what it must accomplish, independently of the selected ticket.
ProcessorPromptHelp: Optional operating instructions that refine how to carry out the mission. KittyClaw appends them after the mission and before memory, skills, and the result contract.
ProcessorModelHelp: Model used by the column agent. Automatic uses the project's local model when configured, otherwise the default model of the selected provider.
ProcessorPromptHint: Detailed instructions appended after the mission, before skills and the result contract.
ProcessorTicketOrderHelp: Determines which eligible ticket KittyClaw selects first when several tickets are waiting in the column.
ProcessorMaxAttemptsHelp: Total number of executions allowed when processing fails. After the last attempt, KittyClaw applies the technical-failure destination when configured.
ProcessorRetryDelayHelp: Initial delay before retrying failed processing. KittyClaw then increases it exponentially, up to 24 hours.
ProcessorTurnLimitHelp: Maximum number of internal agent turns allowed to process one ticket. Reaching this limit fails the current attempt.
ProcessorSkillsHint: Available skills can be used; recommended skills are suggested; required skills must be reported as used before routing succeeds.
ProcessorNoSkills: No project skill is defined yet. You can create them from Workflows.
ProcessorAvailableHelp: KittyClaw injects this skill's instructions into the profile with the “available” level. The agent may use it when useful.
ProcessorRecommendedHelp: KittyClaw injects this skill's instructions and marks it as recommended for the mission, without blocking routing when it is unused.
ProcessorRequiredHelp: KittyClaw injects this skill as required and refuses routing until the agent reports it in skillsUsed in its structured result.
ProcessorDefaultDestinationHelp: Column used when the result returned by the agent matches no conditional route. Without an applicable destination, the attempt fails.
ProcessorFailureDestinationHelp: Column to which KittyClaw moves the ticket after all attempts are exhausted. If empty, the ticket remains in its column with a failed execution.
ProcessorOutcomeHelp: Text value the agent must return in the outcome field of its JSON result. Route matching is case-insensitive.
ProcessorRouteDestinationHelp: Column to which KittyClaw atomically moves the ticket when the matching outcome is returned.
ColumnActionsNeedsProcessor: Add a processor before configuring its actions
ColumnActionsHint: These deterministic actions surround the column's single agent. KittyClaw stores a checkpoint after each success.
ColumnActionsBeforeHint: Prepare the ticket or call an external system before starting the agent.
ColumnActionsAfterHint: Run output effects after the agent's structured result and before final routing.
ColumnAgentStepHint: The single step that uses the mission, prompt, memory, model, and skills configured in the Processor tab.
ColumnActionFailureDestinationHelp: When this action fails, KittyClaw stops execution and moves the ticket here. Without a destination, the processor retry policy applies, followed by its technical-failure destination.
ColumnNameHelp: Name displayed on the board and used as the readable ticket status. Renaming the column does not change its stable technical identity.
ColumnColorHelp: Color used to visually identify the column and its tickets on the board.
ColumnRoleHelp: Functional meaning of the column. Owner action required automatically assigns tickets to Owner; Waiting remains suitable for normal pauses such as Blocked or Scheduled.
ColumnPositionHelp: Location of the column in its pipeline. KittyClaw reorders the board without changing the column's stable identity.
ColumnStableIdentityHint: The column keeps its stable identity when its name, color, role, or position changes.
ColumnDeleteHint: Tickets will be moved to another column. Processor links targeting this column will be safely removed.
ColumnNoProcessorHint: This column remains manual until you attach a generic processor.
ColumnRoutingNeedsProcessor: Add a processor before configuring routing
ColumnRoutingHint: Route each structured outcome to the appropriate destination column.
ColumnNameAlreadyExists: A column with this name already exists in the pipeline.
ColumnDeleteFailed: The column could not be deleted.
ColumnSchedulesHint: Run deterministic actions on a schedule without launching an agent. To schedule agent work, create a ticket in this column; its processor will use the model configured above.
ColumnNoSchedules: No scheduled task for this column.
ScheduleNameHelp: Name shown in the interface and used as the author in ticket activity.
ScheduleCronHelp: Five-field cron schedule: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week.
ScheduleCalendarHelp: Choose a readable frequency, days and times. KittyClaw stores the equivalent cron schedule internally.
ScheduleTimezoneHelp: IANA or Windows time zone in which KittyClaw interprets the cron expression.
ScheduleTicketScopeHelp: Choose whether actions run without a ticket or against the first ticket in this column.
ScheduleFailureHelp: On failure, stop the task and move its target ticket to this column. An uncertain action is never replayed automatically.
ChatCommandBlocked: A command attempt was blocked by the security policy
ChatCommandWarning: The command reported a technical warning
